continuationGovernor.stopReason: Production 0031 is applied and verified. A Vercel deployment is currently blocked by the free-plan daily deployment cap, so the migration was redesigned and TDD-verified to use Hostinger itself as the one-time V1-to-V2 rotation bridge behind an explicit temporary enable flag and the existing dedicated bearer token. Exact code head 974506b7 passed CI #1358 and Browser QA #1257. A frozen release/hostinger-v2-bridge-20260824 branch now points to that SHA. The next safe step requires owner-controlled secrets: copy the existing valid production QUIZ_ENCRYPTION_KEY_V1 from Vercel into Hostinger unchanged, then create/configure a new V2 key and temporary rotation token in Hostinger. No account connector can read or safely transfer those secret values.

rules: Treat feat/mystery-foundation as canonical until final release promotion
Use TDD RED before behavior changes
Require fresh CI, build, browser, release-health, live-product and database evidence before success claims
Never expose questionnaire keys, rotation tokens, OTPs, sessions, raw answers, addresses, payment secrets or provider secrets
Never replace QUIZ_ENCRYPTION_KEY_V1; copy the existing valid value unchanged when a second runtime must read V1 data
New questionnaire writes use V2 on the compatible Hostinger release
Do not start V1-to-V2 row rotation until Hostinger has passed final-domain live proof; after rotation begins, the old V1-only Vercel release is no longer a safe rollback target
Hostinger rotation endpoint is enabled only when RUNTIME_PROVIDER=hostinger AND QUIZ_KEY_ROTATION_HOSTINGER_BRIDGE=enabled and a valid dedicated token is supplied
Stop rotation immediately on any failed row and retain V1
Browser navigation is never payment proof
Do not configure REFERRAL_ATTRIBUTION_SIGNING_KEY before migration 0029 is separately approved, applied and verified
Do not create real charges solely for QA

hostingerMigration.promotionRule: Do not switch Hostinger to the V2 candidate until the existing V1 key, new V2 key, temporary rotation token and Hostinger bridge enable flag are safely configured.
hostingerMigration.rotationRule: Do not invoke rotation on the temporary domain or before issuedonce.shop has passed final-domain Hostinger proof.
